question: If $A(adj~A)= \begin{bmatrix}2026&0&0\\ 0&2026&0\\ 0&0&2026\end{bmatrix},$ then the value of |adj A| is equal to:
explanation:
**Step 1:** Use the matrix property $A(\text{adj } A) = |A|I$. Factoring out the scalar from the given diagonal matrix yields $2026 \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$, which means $|A| = 2026$.
**Step 2:** Apply the determinant property for adjoints of an $n \times n$ matrix: $|\text{adj } A| = |A|^{n-1}$.
**Step 3:** Since the matrix order is $3 \times 3$, $n = 3$. Substituting the values gives $|\text{adj } A| = (2026)^{3-1} = (2026)^2$.
